scientific_integrity: Conditional probabilities follow from exact polynomial coefficient extraction; exhaustive finite checks are corroborative and do not supply the all-size proof. This is a new mathematical statement built using previously established methods.
scientific_limitations: Complete bipartite hosts, uniformly sampled spanning trees, full feasible labeled degree sequences, and distinct edge pairs only; arbitrary hosts, partial degree conditioning, and association of general increasing events are not proved. The transfer-current determinant is prior theory and historical priority requires independent checking.
title: Conditional edge correlations in degree-constrained complete-bipartite spanning trees
